title: fix(devin): resolve repo/path for Devin CLI sessions in bottom bar
context:
find_session_cwd() had no branch for devincli-* sessions, so the
conv-input-context strip's workspace pill never rendered for them.
Reuse the existing _devin_cli_session_cwd() DB lookup, matching the
pattern already used for every other engine.
